note: Production-optimized isolated six-card fixture using react-dom/profiling, not the full route, physical device, or live traffic. Profiling instrumentation adds overhead. React Profiler actualDuration only; not end-to-end latency or production speedup. Parent-update timing begins after six detail queries and closed counters settle. Interaction timing begins before the first expansion and includes expanded mounts, first nearby-query completion and its React updates, tab/scroll settlement updates, close and reopen. Nearby readiness and tab/text settlement are required before content capture, not before the interaction timing reset. React actualDuration excludes network waiting and idle settlement time; it is not elapsed interaction latency. Date wall-clock is fixed; timers and performance.now remain real. Initial closed-card loading and real-clock freshness are not measured. Four order-balanced pairs. Positive change means slower. Timing improvements are not asserted; all raw regressions are retained. Correctness and transform checks are gates. Production gating needs the actual app scope check, optimized whole-page runs, cross-browser functional QA and human review.
